parameters.content:
## Setup checklist
1. Sheet ID pre-set · tab Sheet1
2. Replace REPLACE_GITHUB_OWNER / REPLACE_REPO in GitHub + HTML nodes
3. Groq Header Auth: Bearer gsk_...
4. Google Sheets + Gmail OAuth2
5. Activate workflow
6. Sheet columns: ID, CityOrCountry, UserEmail, Status, GeneratedHTML, GitHubHTMLLink, GitHubJSONBackupLink, MapLink, Attractions, Coordinates, UserComment, Version, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt
